notes: MERGED 2026-10-03 from me_coalitions.json + me_orgs.json. Coalition agent: Coalitions with no public member list: Maine Climate & Health Alliance (steering committee is individual health professionals), ClimateWork Maine (business network, no list shown), Maine Clean Communities (no stakeholder list on pages read), Divest Maine (its site could not be fetched; description comes from Maine Youth for Climate Justice's page and a Sierra Club Maine page). Environmental Priorities Coalition: site says 42 members (other pages say 39-40), only 35 are named on its members page, so 7 are omitted. MAINECAN: reported over 100 members; only those named on its pages are listed, and ClimateWork Maine and the Adaptation Providers Network (listed as MAINECAN allies) and Maine Climate Action Now are not shown as members to avoid duplicate nodes. Maine Climate Action Now is also a member of Fight the Hike and the Wabanaki Alliance Coalition; Maine Climate & Health Alliance is an ally of MCAN; those memberships are not represented as edges because they are coalitions rather than organizations. Wabanaki Alliance Tribal Coalition: its page says 150-300+ members and shows a selection; only climate, environment, faith and sector-relevant ones (about 18) are listed; ACLU of Maine, Maine Women's Lobby, EqualityMaine, League of Women Voters of Maine, Luke's Lobster, Good Tern Co-op and the UMaine School of Social Work were left out as not climate related. Its Nihkaniyane celebration is on 2026-10-01, before the cutoff. Transportation for Maine's list also names a Kathadin Collaborative, left out because the spelling could not be confirmed. Adaptation Providers Network: page says about 36 organizations; only named ones listed; Boston College, EPA, NOAA and USFWS left out. Coordinates are town centres (approx); orgs with no known Maine office use Augusta with remote true. Websites left blank where the group's own site was not seen. WebFetch was blocked for divestmaine.org and t4me.org, so Transportation for Maine details come from NRCM and WABI articles. Maine Council of Churches is listed as an EPC member only (it is a council of denominations; its own member list was not read). last_activity is blank for most member organizations because only coalition-level pages were read. No coalition-run events were found after 2026-10-03 apart from Evening for the Environment (2026-10-15, hosted by Maine Conservation Voters and Maine Conservation Alliance) and two ClimateWork Maine webinars. Standalone-org ids (me_nrcm, me_sierra_club_maine etc.) may overlap with another file; entries here are minimal. | Org agent: WebFetch was permission-blocked for many sites (nrcm.org, sierraclub.org, gmri.org, maineaudubon.org, mofga.org, islandinstitute.org, clf.org, efficiencymaine.com, mothersoutfront.org, cascobay.org, meeassociation.org), so orgs marked with only search-result sources (NRCM, Sierra Club ME, CLF, TNC, Audubon, MPA, GMRI, Island Institute, ACTT, FOCB, Cultivating Community, MOFGA, MEEA, MeIPL, XR Midcoast, CCL chapters, Sunrise Franklin County) have short generic descriptions, no events and approximate locations; type 'unknown'. HQ towns for MPA, CLF, ACTT, Cultivating Community, MCAN, MYCJ, 350 Maine, Sierra Club ME approximate (Portland). Not included: Mothers Out Front Maine (search found no Maine team), Maine Rivers, Maine Climate Hub, Efficiency Maine, Portland Climate Action, 350 local teams, Sunrise hubs other than Franklin County, Maine Clean Energy (nothing confirmed). Maine Climate Council event locations not given on calendar summary; online status unconfirmed.
